evals.prompt: Define autonomous loop patterns for an AI agent system in 2-3 sentences. A correct answer must state that they are reusable control shapes for repeated agent execution, and must mention stop conditions, progress signals, checkpoint/respawn behavior, and safety caps.

Describe the mental model for autonomous loop patterns by naming at least four primitives and explaining how Ralph Wiggum, manage-loop, and grind-loop place those primitives differently. A correct answer must include trigger, worker session, progress signal, stop condition, and safety cap.

Why do autonomous loop patterns exist as a named skill rather than ad hoc scripting? A correct answer must explain the failure mode of uncapped or uncheckpointed loops and how named patterns let the system pick the smallest safe loop shape.

Autonomous loop patterns are often confused with command selection, task execution, agent control, and inter-agent messaging. Explain the boundary to each. A correct answer must route command choice to ai-coding-agents, implementation to task-execution, steering/budget to agent-control, and messaging to agent-to-agent or agent-messaging.

Classify Ralph Wiggum, manage-loop, and grind-loop by complexity, continuation mechanism, and best use case. A correct answer must identify Ralph Wiggum as simplest for one clear task, manage-loop as continuation-signal based for orchestrated backlog work, and grind-loop as an external supervisor for fresh-session respawn and throughput.

Use the autopilot-mode analogy for autonomous loop patterns and map it to concrete repo mechanisms. A correct answer must map instruments to status/checkpoint/telemetry, altitude limits to iteration or bad-exit caps, and pilot handoff to stop conditions or human review.

Novel scenario: an agent must clear a small queue of 4 well-specified docs tasks overnight. Choose a loop pattern and list the required safety mechanisms. A correct answer must choose the simplest adequate pattern, explain when grind-loop would be justified instead, and include completion signals, a cap, persisted status, and observability evidence. It must not say an unbounded loop is acceptable.
